editorial:
Imagine being a pre-teen who is already a professional troublemaker. That is exactly where you find Junior in this movie. He is older now, but he still has that mischievous streak that makes life difficult for everyone around him. The whole plot kicks off when Junior develops a huge crush on a girl in his class. The problem is that he has some serious competition. He has to go up against a famous child star, a star hockey player, and a perfect Boy Scout. It turns into a full-blown war of pranks and tricks as Junior tries to prove he is the best choice for her heart. The vibe is very light and silly, making it a perfect choice for a lazy afternoon.

You will notice that the movie relies heavily on slapstick humor and kid-friendly chaos. While it is not a deep story, the energy stays high throughout. The acting is exactly what you expect from a 90s TV movie, which gives it a cozy, nostalgic feel. If you love goofy comedies, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick laugh, or if you are a collector, adding the Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this piece of nostalgia. It is a simple, fun ride that does not take itself too seriously.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head during a big competition where Junior and his rivals try to impress the girl. After all the fighting and pranks, Junior proves that being himself is better than pretending to be perfect. He eventually wins over the girl by showing his true personality. The movie wraps up with Junior finally getting the girl and his rivals learning a lesson about humility. It ends on a happy, light note with Junior still being a bit of a rebel.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 90s kid comedies and goofy pranks.
